5.18
Citation Engine
The Citation Engine provides transparency for every generated answer.
Instead of producing unsupported responses, the system identifies the exact source of
every retrieved statement.
Each citation includes:
• Document Name
• Document ID
• Page Number
• Chunk Number
• Similarity Score
Duplicate citations are automatically removed before presenting the final response.
This enables users to verify generated answers directly from the original document.
5.19
Advantages of the AI Implementation
The implemented AI pipeline provides several advantages.
• Secure local AI execution
• Fast semantic retrieval
• Workspace isolation
• High retrieval accuracy
• Reduced hallucination
• Explainable AI through citations
• Modular implementation
• Easy future scalability
• Support for multiple document formats
